gold_posts.hook: My starter wakes up before I do.
gold_posts.caption: I feed the levain at 10pm, and by morning it's doubled and ready. That slow overnight rise is what gives the loaf its tang and that open, custardy crumb. No shortcuts, just time. 🌙
